anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: If our Passover has been sacrificed, Christ.
Wanting to return to Egypt and so not entering the land.
The wish to go back into Egypt.
Those who turn back do not enter.

choices.why: Book I will deny that the passion is the Passover-type; the holy sacrifice and eat him.

pass_a_gloss: And if our pascha was sacrificed, Jesus Christ, those sacrificing Christ come out of Egypt and go through the sea and will see Pharaoh being sunk; but if some of them want to return into Egypt, they will not enter the holy land.
pass_b_english: And if our Passover has been sacrificed, Jesus Christ, those who sacrifice Christ come out of Egypt and pass through the sea and will see Pharaoh drowned. But if some of them want to go back into Egypt, they will not enter the holy land (1 Corinthians 5:7) (Numbers 14:3–4) (Exodus 16:3) (Hebrews 3:11–19).
